confirmation.user_reply: 補比較契約 v1.1：loss 分母為零（region 沒有受監督分量）的 case 標為 no_supervision，不計入 loss／梯度比較、單獨計數，不當成 NaN 失敗。寫進契約並推送到 PR #50。

change_policy: Tickets 3-5 execute this version unchanged; any change needs a new version with its own user confirmation and must not be derived from formal results

seed_groups.selection: torch CPU randperm with generator seed 43002, prefix 8, no replacement for infeasible or duplicate candidates
seed_groups.paired_common_subset: select loss groups with the 2-ring budget, then add 1 or 2 rings; a seed infeasible for 2 rings is reported with its own 1-ring result and excluded from the paired halo comparison
seed_groups.deduplication: by loss-group set within each halo setting; duplicates kept and mapped, not counted as independent
seed_groups.baseline_feasibility: all seed groups feasible for halo 1 and 2

forward_matrix.baseline_note: all baseline regions cover the whole protein at budget 896; Ticket 3 is tool-consistency evidence only, truncated forward evidence comes from 6sup_A in Ticket 4

training_matrix.comparison: paired same supervision: identical weights, noise, t, loss residues, masks, denominators, fresh identical Adam state; record pre-clip gradients, clipping and actual optimizer delta

baselines.regions: full coverage only (no truncation at budget 896)

training_matrix.truncated_policy: descriptive only; no training-approximation pass is issued

control_tolerances.relative_applies_to: parameter groups whose reference RMS is above the near-zero cutoff
control_tolerances.near_zero_policy: relative difference, norm ratio and cosine null; keep raw norms, RMS and absolute differences; count exact zero, one-sided zero and missing groups separately
control_tolerances.required_alignment: finite values, identical noise and mask hashes, equal effective denominators, same t, same initial weights and optimizer state
control_tolerances.per_group: every parameter group must pass; no averaging across groups
control_tolerances.applies_to: zero-truncation controls only (same-path repeat and full coverage); never to truncated cases

training_matrix.loss_normalization: same masked squared error numerator and effective mask denominator on both sides; both denominators saved per case and checked equal (training-policy-proposal.md)

zero_loss_denominator.condition: effective loss-mask denominator is zero: the region has no supervised component
zero_loss_denominator.loss_and_gradient_comparison: excluded from loss, gradient and update comparisons
zero_loss_denominator.counting: counted separately per stratum, like infeasible and duplicate candidates
zero_loss_denominator.failure_status: not a NaN/Inf failure and not a pass
zero_loss_denominator.nonfinite_rule_unchanged: a NaN or Inf with a non-zero denominator still fails the case

capacity_status.same_shape_unmeasured: cases not run within pilot job budgets (11 in job 49479, 28 in job 49501); same batch shape as measured R1, capacity not measured

phase1_infeasible.reason: CUDA OOM in backward at 96 frames with the default memory settings, and at 250 frames with the default settings (job 49501) and with each of group_batch_size 1, plus ffn_chunk_size 8192, plus expandable_segments (job 49513)

capacity_status.unmeasured_frame_counts: between 64 and 96 for the 6sup_A full-protein training step
capacity_status.same_shape_unmeasured_64_frames: only the 7 cases of job 49515 and the 6sup_A R1 full step of job 49513 were measured at 64 frames; other 64-frame cases are same shape unmeasured
capacity_status.same_shape_unmeasured_t_and_seed: capacity measured at t 0.5 and noise seed 0 only; other t and seeds are same shape unmeasured

reporting.pooling: no pooled pass across proteins or boundaries; every non-empty stratum must meet its threshold
reporting.replicas_and_frames: not independent proteins or spatial samples

failure_policy.nonfinite: case fails; counted separately; never dropped
failure_policy.oom_missing_gpu_timeout_program_error: kept as separate failure classes with stage, exit code and log
failure_policy.same_shape_unmeasured_case_failure: recorded under this policy, not silently removed

known_limits: 400 ps interval is documented by the upstream paper but not stored in the checkpoint
checkpoint trained with crop=256 and 250 frames; full proteins, 64 frames and 4 frames are extrapolation
independence of the four proteins from training data was only sequence-screened
results describe a fixed feasible subset and a single optimizer step
control tolerances were calibrated on baseline R1, noise seed 0, t 0.5 only; applying them to other replicas, t and seeds is an unverified extension
paired same-supervision training comparison for truncated regions is not implemented yet; the current control supports full coverage only; this is Ticket 5 implementation scope

supersedes.change: adds the zero loss-denominator policy only; every v1 decision is unchanged
